cases.sentence: Иов проклял день, когда он появился на ___.
cases.explain: The verb 'появился' (came) with preposition 'на' governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Пусть тот день станет ___, пусть Бог с высоты не вспомнит о нем.
cases.explain: The verb 'станет' (become) governs the instrumental case for a predicate noun.

cases.sentence: Пусть тот день достанется ___ и мгле.
cases.explain: The verb 'достанется' (belong/fall to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Пусть проклянут эту ночь те, кто способен разбудить ___.
cases.explain: The verb 'разбудить' (awaken) governs the accusative case; here it's the accusative form of the proper noun.

cases.sentence: Я думаю о горе и ___ которые пришли ко мне.
cases.explain: The preposition 'о' (about) can govern the accusative or genitive; here showing connection.

cases.sentence: Зачем я рожден и зачем вскармливается человек ___?
cases.explain: The verb 'вскармливается' (is fed/nourished) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Я лежал бы сейчас в мире, спал бы себе спокойно, среди царей и мудрецов ___, которые строили себе то, что ныне в руинах.
cases.explain: The construction 'мудрецов земли' uses genitive to show possession/relationship.

cases.sentence: На что дан страдальцу свет и жизнь тому, чья ___ скорбит?
cases.explain: The noun 'душа' is the subject of the clause 'чья душа скорбит' (whose soul grieves).

reading.ru: После этого Иов заговорил и проклял день, когда он появился на свет.
reading.question: What did Job do after his friends' visit?
options: He spoke and cursed the day of his birth
He offered sacrifices to ask God for forgiveness
He reconciled with his wife and family
He accepted his suffering with humility and patience
reading.correct: He spoke and cursed the day of his birth
reading.explain: The text states: 'Иов заговорил и проклял день, когда он появился на свет' (Job spoke and cursed the day when he was born).

reading.ru: Да сгинет день, когда я родился, и ночь, когда сказали, ребенок зачат.
reading.question: What does Job curse in his first lament?
options: The day of his birth and the night when he was conceived
The people who caused his suffering
God's judgment and the world's injustice
His family for not supporting him
reading.correct: The day of his birth and the night when he was conceived
reading.explain: Job's explicit curse: 'Да сгинет день, когда я родился, и ночь, когда сказали, ребенок зачат' (Perish the day I was born and the night when my conception was announced).

reading.ru: Пусть тот день станет тьмой, пусть Бог с высоты не вспомнит о нем, пусть свет в тот день не сияет, пусть он достанется мраку и мгле.
reading.question: What does Job want to happen to the day of his birth?
options: That it become darkness, forgotten by God, without light, given to darkness and gloom
That it be celebrated as a day of lamentation for all people
That it become a holy day of remembrance and fasting
That all people avoid any work on that day forever
reading.correct: That it become darkness, forgotten by God, without light, given to darkness and gloom
reading.explain: Job's detailed curse: 'станет тьмой', 'не вспомнит о нем', 'не сияет', 'достанется мраку и мгле' (become darkness, be forgotten, have no light, belong to darkness and gloom).

reading.ru: Почему не погиб я при родах и не умер сразу же после рождения?
reading.question: What does Job lament about his birth?
options: That he did not die during childbirth or immediately after birth
That he was born into a poor family without resources
That his parents did not recognize his future suffering
That he was rejected by society from the moment of birth
reading.correct: That he did not die during childbirth or immediately after birth
reading.explain: Job's lament is explicit: 'Почему не погиб я при родах и не умер сразу же после рождения?' (Why did I not perish at my mother's breast? Why did I not die immediately after birth?).

reading.ru: Зачем не зарыли меня, как мертворожденного, как младенца, который не увидел света?
reading.question: With whom does Job wish he could be compared?
options: With a stillborn child or an infant who never saw light
With ancient kings and wise men who found peace
With sinners who were punished during their lifetime
With those who lived short lives but were honored greatly
reading.correct: With a stillborn child or an infant who never saw light
reading.explain: Job's wish: 'как мертворожденного, как младенца, который не увидел света' (like a stillborn or an infant who never saw light).

reading.ru: Чего я боялся, то и произошло, чего страшился, то со мной и случилось.
reading.question: What has happened to Job's fears?
options: All his fears have come to pass
His fears have been proven unfounded
He has learned to overcome his fears
His fears have been replaced by hope
reading.correct: All his fears have come to pass
reading.explain: Job's statement: 'Чего я боялся, то и произошло, чего страшился, то со мной и случилось' (What I feared has come upon me; what I dreaded has happened to me).
